classes.name: potato
classes.description: 完整的土豆或块状马铃薯，有浅褐色表皮，属于厨余有机物
classes.semantic_description: A dense moist organic tuber with high water content, a cool thermal response, low electrical conductivity, and a mild earthy odor.

classes.name: rabbitcut
classes.description: 切分后的兔肉或带骨肉块，呈红粉色并可能含脂肪组织
classes.semantic_description: A moist animal-tissue piece with high water content, soft texture, moderate conductivity, and a noticeable organic odor response.

classes.name: battery1
classes.description: 一号圆柱形干电池，体积较大，金属正负极明显
classes.semantic_description: A heavy rigid electrochemical cell with a metal casing, high thermal mass, conductive terminals, no moisture, and little odor.

classes.name: battery5
classes.description: 五号圆柱形干电池，细长金属外壳，属于有害垃圾
classes.semantic_description: A compact dense electrochemical cell with a cylindrical metal shell, conductive terminals, no moisture, and little odor.

classes.name: bottle
classes.description: 普通透明或有色塑料饮料瓶，带瓶口和瓶身标签
classes.semantic_description: A light hollow polymer container with low thermal mass, low conductivity, little retained moisture, and weak odor.

classes.name: brick
classes.description: 红色或灰色建筑砖块，表面粗糙且为规则长方体
classes.semantic_description: A heavy porous mineral block with high thermal mass, low electrical conductivity, low moisture, and nearly no odor.

classes.name: can
classes.description: 圆柱形金属易拉罐，具有拉环顶盖和印刷包装
classes.semantic_description: A light hollow metal container with a conductive wall, rapid thermal response, little moisture, and weak residual odor.

classes.name: china
classes.description: 破损陶瓷或瓷片，坚硬光滑，断面锋利
classes.semantic_description: A rigid dense ceramic fragment with moderate thermal mass, very low conductivity, no moisture, and no odor.

classes.name: stone
classes.description: 天然石块或碎石，形状不规则，表面粗糙
classes.semantic_description: A dense irregular mineral object with high thermal mass, low conductivity, low moisture, and no odor.

classes.name: drug
classes.description: 药片泡罩板或散装药品，属于过期药物类有害垃圾
classes.semantic_description: A small medicinal item or blister unit with low mass, limited moisture, mixed polymer and foil conductivity, and a weak chemical odor.

classes.name: drugbag
classes.description: 软质药品包装袋，带药品文字或铝塑复合包装
classes.semantic_description: A light thin pharmaceutical pouch with low thermal mass, low moisture, mixed film conductivity, and a weak chemical odor.

classes.name: mooli
classes.description: 完整白萝卜或萝卜段，白色肉质并可能带绿色叶柄
classes.semantic_description: A heavy water-rich root vegetable with high moisture, a cool thermal response, moderate conductivity, and a fresh organic odor.

classes.name: battery
classes.description: 常见废旧电池，圆柱或方形，有金属电极，属于有害垃圾
classes.semantic_description: A dense rigid battery with metal electrodes, conductive surfaces, no moisture, high thermal mass, and little odor.

classes.name: bottle2
classes.description: 另一类塑料或玻璃瓶容器，具有清晰瓶颈与中空瓶身
classes.semantic_description: A hollow bottle made of glass or rigid polymer with low moisture, low odor, and material-dependent thermal mass and conductivity.

classes.name: drugbox
classes.description: 硬纸质药品盒，表面印有药名、剂量或医药标识
classes.semantic_description: A light dry paperboard package with low thermal mass, very low conductivity, little moisture, and a weak paper or medicine odor.

classes.name: papercup
classes.description: 一次性纸杯，圆台形薄壁容器，杯口呈圆环
classes.semantic_description: A light paper-based cup with low conductivity and thermal mass, possibly slight retained moisture, and a weak beverage odor.

classes.name: capsule
classes.description: 药用胶囊或胶囊包装，呈小型双色椭圆柱形
classes.semantic_description: A very light dry pharmaceutical capsule with low thermal mass, low conductivity, little moisture, and a weak medicinal odor.

classes.name: potatocut
classes.description: 切开的土豆块，可见淡黄色内部和局部褐色表皮
classes.semantic_description: A moist cut tuber with exposed water-rich tissue, moderate conductivity, a cool thermal response, and a mild earthy odor.

classes.name: paper
classes.description: 废纸张、纸片或折叠纸制品，薄而平整
classes.semantic_description: A light dry cellulose sheet with very low conductivity and thermal mass, little moisture, and a weak paper odor.
